cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My small trophy wins on storage. Put yours beside it and measure the space each needs, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is the consolation prize. Mine is first place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's rank, not storage. Keep the handles inside your measurement; they don't become invisible because you won.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The handles frame the word 'FIRST'. That's what people will look at.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then compare restraint. Mine only has the date; yours needs its result in capitals. Read both inscriptions aloud and tell me which asks for less attention.
